KTMnav 1.1 · Independent companion app\n:
KTMnav 1.1 · Independent companion app
All features included. No account required.
An independent navigation companion for:
An independent navigation companion for compatible KTM and Husqvarna dashboards. Not affiliated with either manufacturer.

Built from observed protocol behavior. No subscriptions, accounts, analytics or hosted service. Navigation and media data are processed on your phone.

Uses OpenDash (MIT), Locus API (MIT), LiteRT (Apache 2.0) and Chakra Petch (SIL Open Font License). Physical dashboard compatibility requires testing on your motorcycle.
